sentences.text: 10. 1. The matter was on Board yesterday (10.12.2024).
Since none appeared for the informant, to give another opportunity to the informant who is represented by a counsel, the matter was posted to this day.
2. There is no appearance on behalf of the informant when the matter is called.

3. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.
4.

The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with C.T. Case No.2353 of 2022 pending in the Court of learned S.D.J.M., Bhubaneswar, arising out of Bhubaneswar Mahila P.S. Case No.48 of 2022 for alleged commission of offence punishable under Sections 493/420/506/34 of IPC.

sentences.text:
5. Learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that taking into account the nature of allegation,
Petitioner may be released on pre-arrest bail.
6. Learned counsel for the State, referring to the 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the informant, opposes the prayer for bail.

7. Considering the materials on record and taking into account that in the meanwhile charge sheet has been filed on 04.11.2022, this Court directs that in the event of arrest of the Petitioner in Ardhendu Sekhar Rath vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190485129/
1 connection with the aforesaid case, he shall be released on bail by the learned Court in seisin on such terms and conditions deemed just and proper.
